title: Grateful Dead Live at Roosevelt Stadium on 1973-07-31
taper: Audio discs provided by Greg Weister

ai_review.summary: Crisp audience tape captures a hot 1973 performance highlighted by an epic Playin' and soaring Dark Star despite a modest setlist.
ai_review.review: The audience recording is surprisingly crisp for a ’73 Aud source, delivering a listenable mix that lets the band’s energy shine through.  The show is praised for its high‑octane playing – especially the massive Playin’ in the first set and the Dark Star/China Cat > Riders “Joy” jam – even though the second set was cut short and the overall song list isn’t packed with secondary jams.

ai_rating.rationale: All four reviewers rate the show highly (mostly 4–5 stars) and highlight superb performances, while noting the audience source is crisp but not audiophile‑grade; this yields a strong combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crisp and clear for a 1973 audience recording; listeners note it’s listenable with enough ambience, though not a high‑fidelity audiophile source.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > Riders on the Storm ("Joy" jam)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set solid but light on secondary jams; second set appears truncated, ending with a monster Playin' that serves as the high point of an otherwise hot show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as "off the wall animated" and delivering A+++ playing throughout.
